blocks.text: SUBIC BAY FREEPORT — The United States (US) has turned over two unmanned surface vessels worth more than $8 million to the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) to bolster the country’s maritime surveillance and security capabilities, the US embassy said on Tuesday (Nov. 10) In a statement, US embassy said that US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton handed over the American-made Devil Ray T38 vessels to Philippine Marine Corps Deputy Commandant Brig. Gen. Bayani V. Curaming during a ceremony on Nov. 4 at the newly opened Unmanned Center of Excellence of US defense firm Maritime Tactical Systems Inc. (MARTAC) […]...
